record.body:
## Problem

A task has no record of how big it is or how long the agent who will do it should take. The phase body records session shape as `one sitting` or `more than one`, and the work-item records `executor` as `inline` or `subagent`. Neither is a duration. An hour estimate is the wrong scale for agentic coding. The dashboard cannot show an estimate that was never written.

## Approach

Decisions: task-agent-estimate, glance-run-facts.

Each new work-item stores `size` (`S`, `M`, or `L`) and `minutes` (a non-negative integer) for its executor. Absent means unset, and zero minutes is a real estimate. `plan-phase` writes both with the executor. A missing executor means the minutes are for a subagent. Size and minutes are not derived from each other.

The phase does not store either field. Inline minutes in a wave add. A subagent wave's elapsed estimate is its longest task. Phase elapsed time adds those wave figures in wave order. The sitting line stays. There is no hours field.

Dashboard display waits for a later phase. When that phase shows the sitting line and the executor, it uses title suffixes. This phase does not render size, minutes, the sitting line, or the executor.

## Exit criteria

`contract/project-design.json` allows optional `size` (`S`, `M`, `L`) and optional `minutes` on `project:work-item`. `skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md` requires both on each new work-item and states the inline sum, the subagent-wave maximum, the phase elapsed time, and the sitting line. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py -q` passes. The phase does not change `dashboard/`.

payload.title: Record task size and the executing agent's minutes
